chunks.ar: دخل جندي مدينة الإسكندرية ونزل في خان للمسافرين،
chunks.en_old: A soldier arrived in Alexandria
chunks.en_new: A soldier arrived in Alexandria and stayed at an inn for travelers,

chunks.ar: وكان يحمل كيسًا فيه ألف قطعة ذهبية.
chunks.en_old: with a purse of a thousand gold pieces.
chunks.en_new: with a purse of a thousand gold pieces.

chunks.ar: نام بعض الليل، ثم استيقظ ليجد حقيبته ممزقة والمال مسروقًا.
chunks.en_old: Overnight someone cut open his saddlebags and stole it,
chunks.en_new: He slept part of the night, then woke to find his bag slit open and the money stolen.

chunks.ar: أسرع إلى رئيس الشرطة حسام الدين يشكو ما حدث.
chunks.en_old: so he complained to Husam al-Din, the police chief.
chunks.en_new: He hurried to the police chief, Husam al-Din, to report what had happened.

chunks.ar: أمر رئيس الشرطة بالقبض على جميع من كانوا في الخان،
chunks.en_old: The chief detained everyone at the inn
chunks.en_new: The police chief ordered everyone at the inn arrested,

chunks.ar: مع أنهم لم يُتهموا بدليل واضح.
chunks.en_old: and prepared to beat them
chunks.en_new: though there was no clear evidence against them.

chunks.ar: وفي الصباح أحضر العصي استعدادًا لضربهم حتى يعترف أحدهم،
chunks.en_old: into a confession,
chunks.en_new: In the morning he brought out sticks to beat them until one of them confessed,

chunks.ar: بينما وقف الجندي ينتظر استعادة نقوده.
chunks.en_old: despite lacking proof against any one guest.
chunks.en_new: while the soldier stood waiting to get his money back.

chunks.ar: قبل بدء الضرب شق رجل طريقه بين الحاضرين
chunks.en_old: Before the beating began,
chunks.en_new: Before the beating began, a man pushed his way through the crowd

chunks.ar: وصاح: دعوا هؤلاء الأبرياء، فأنا الذي أخذت المال!
chunks.en_old: a stranger stepped forward, confessed,
chunks.en_new: and shouted: Let these innocent people go, I am the one who took the money!

chunks.ar: أخرج كيس الذهب من كمه ووضعه أمام رئيس الشرطة والجندي،
chunks.en_old: and placed the purse before the chief.
chunks.en_new: He took the purse of gold from his sleeve and set it before the police chief and the soldier,

chunks.ar: فتنفس المسافرون المحبوسون الصعداء.
chunks.en_old: The detained travelers were relieved.
chunks.en_new: The detained travelers were relieved.

chunks.ar: أثنى الناس على اعتراف الرجل،
chunks.en_old: People praised the confession,
chunks.en_new: People praised the confession,

chunks.ar: لكنه قال إن براعته الحقيقية ليست في إعادة المال،
chunks.en_old: but the man boasted that his cleverest feat
chunks.en_new: but he said his real skill was not in returning the money,

chunks.ar: بل في سرقته مرة ثانية.
chunks.en_old: was stealing the purse a second time.
chunks.en_new: but in stealing it a second time.

chunks.ar: سأله رئيس الشرطة بدهشة كيف فعل ذلك، فبدأ المحتال يروي طريقته من البداية.
chunks.en_old: The chief demanded an explanation.
chunks.en_new: Amazed, the police chief asked how he had done it, and the trickster began explaining from the start.

chunks.ar: قال المحتال إنه رأى الجندي يستلم الذهب في سوق الصيارفة بالقاهرة.
chunks.en_old: The trickster said he had watched the soldier receive the gold in Cairo
chunks.en_new: The trickster said he had seen the soldier receive the gold at the money changers' market in Cairo.

chunks.ar: تبعه من مدينة إلى أخرى دون أن يجد فرصة للسرقة،
chunks.en_old: and followed him from town to town,
chunks.en_new: He followed him from city to city without finding a chance to steal it,

chunks.ar: حتى نزل معه في خان الإسكندرية وراقبه إلى أن غلبه النوم.
chunks.en_old: waiting for an opportunity.
chunks.en_new: until he stayed at the same inn in Alexandria and watched him until he fell asleep.

chunks.ar: شرح كيف شق حقيبة الجندي ليلًا وأخذ المال بهدوء.
chunks.en_old: He described cutting the sleeping soldier’s bag.
chunks.en_new: He explained how he had slit the soldier's bag at night and quietly taken the money.

chunks.ar: ثم مد يده نحو الكيس الموضوع على الطاولة وقال إنه سيُريهم الحركة نفسها.
chunks.en_old: Pretending to demonstrate the theft,
chunks.en_new: Then he reached for the purse on the table, saying he would show them the very same move.

chunks.ar: اقترب الجميع ليتابعوا العرض،
chunks.en_old: he reached for the purse
chunks.en_new: Everyone drew closer to watch the show,

chunks.ar: وهم يظنون أن المال أصبح في أمان.
chunks.en_old: lying openly before them.
chunks.en_new: thinking the money was now safe.

chunks.ar: أمسك الكيس فجأة واندفع خارج المجلس،
chunks.en_old: Suddenly he grabbed the purse, ran outside,
chunks.en_new: Suddenly he grabbed the purse and dashed out of the hall,

chunks.ar: ثم قفز في بركة ماء قريبة
chunks.en_old: plunged into a nearby pool,
chunks.en_new: plunged into a nearby pool,

chunks.ar: وفر عبر أزقة الإسكندرية المتصلة.
chunks.en_old: and escaped through Alexandria’s interconnected lanes.
chunks.en_new: and escaped through Alexandria’s interconnected lanes.

chunks.ar: صرخ رئيس الشرطة يأمر بملاحقته، لكن الرجال تأخروا، وعادوا من دون المحتال أو المال.
chunks.en_old: The officers failed to catch him.
chunks.en_new: The police chief shouted for a chase, but his men were too slow and came back without the trickster or the money.

chunks.ar: قال رئيس الشرطة للجندي إنه وجد اللص واستعاد ماله للحظة،
chunks.en_old: The chief insisted the soldier had briefly recovered his money
chunks.en_new: The police chief told the soldier he had found the thief and got his money back for a moment,

chunks.ar: ولذلك لم يعد يستطيع مطالبة أهل الخان بشيء.
chunks.en_old: and could not blame the inn guests.
chunks.en_new: so he could no longer claim anything from the people of the inn.

chunks.ar: خرج الجندي خالي اليدين، ونجا المسافرون من الضرب.
chunks.en_old: The soldier lost his gold, the innocents were spared,
chunks.en_new: The soldier left empty-handed, and the travelers escaped the beating.

chunks.ar: أما المحتال فهرب، تاركًا خلفه فضيحة لرئيس الشرطة.
chunks.en_old: and the thief escaped.
chunks.en_new: As for the trickster, he escaped, leaving the police chief disgraced.
